summary: In a layoff meeting a manager says they cannot give details, and the worker hears a refusal to explain.
realLife: Workers describe layoff meetings where managers and HR say they can't go into the details, which leaves employees without answers and feeling brushed off.
sources: Welcome to the Jungle, frustrating phrases from layoff meetings: https://www.welcometothejungle.com/en/articles/frustrating-phrases-from-layoff-meetings
inGame: a job-ended event carries the call; the employer's reason for the cut sits in the record; needs: severance and a way to say a reason was withheld

turns.summary: The manager says the plant lost an order and names it plainly.
turns.writesBack: the worker is angry but understands; a tie stays intact

turns.summary: The manager reads a short script and leaves the room.
turns.writesBack: a cooler tie and a bitter journal note

turns.summary: The worker asks again why them and not the others.
turns.writesBack: a hard exchange; a grudge recorded
